ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous high-intensity white zones occupy the medial-to-lateral portions of both lobes. These are bisected by a low-intensity, dark-pigmented central wedge extending from the insertion point to the median notch. Dark pixel clusters are concentrated at the distal tips (tips) and along the trailing edge margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 30-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge. Amplitude of peaks varies, with notable coarse jaggedness on the lateral-most 20% of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges follow a primarily convex trajectory from the notch to the distal tips, with a slight recurve near the outer margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of dark, circular-to-ovoid pixel groups are visible on the distal posterior quadrants of both lobes, particularly dense on the right lobe tip, consistent with localized pigmentation or previous attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, high-contrast linear disruptions (white marks against dark background) are visible within the central dark-pigmented region, oriented roughly horizontally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel linear rake marks are visible in the central dark region of the fluke near the peduncle attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct irregular notch or 'bite' indentation is visible on the far distal edge of the right lobe lobe tip.
